subject: [PATCH v2] mm: list_lru: fix NULL deref when a folio moves to the root memcg

reviews.author: Harry Yoo
reviews.summary:
Gave Reviewed-by

Reviewer Harry Yoo noted that reparenting of a folio's cgroup could occur after the initial check, but is safe because __memcg_list_lru_alloc() populates all list_lrus from the memcg to the root hierarchy before reaching the root.
reviews.raw_body:
I was wondering how we make sure reparenting doesn't happen after this,
but apparently it's fine as __memcg_list_lru_alloc() populates all
list_lrus from the memcg up to the hierarchy before the root.

-- 
Cheers,
Harry / Hyeonggon

2026-11-12.patch_summary: This patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference bug that occurs when a folio moves to the root memory cgroup between two lookups. The bug is caused by the slow path of the `folio_memcg_list_lru_alloc` function not checking if the root memcg has its own lists before allocating them. The fix involves adding an additional check for the root memcg using the `memcg_list_lru_allocated` function, similar to the fast path. This prevents a NULL pointer dereference when the folio is moved up to the root between the two lookups.
